reader.requirement: At --std 85 each of the INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O and EXTEND phrases may appear in at most one USE statement of a given Procedure Division (ERROR and EXCEPTION counting as one), so a second USE with the same mode in the same Procedure Division is refused, while one of each mode, and the same mode in a contained program's own Procedure Division, are accepted.
